name: contacts-csv-uploaded-to-shared-documents-folder
description: The sample contacts.csv dropped into the input folder is moved to the output folder; the flow creates '/Shared Documents/${csvImportFolder}' and adds the file content as '/Shared Documents/${csvImportFolder}/contacts.csv' with overwrite=true. The Mule IT reads the file back from SharePoint and asserts it equals the local contacts.csv.

source.reference: importing-a-csv-file-into-ms-sharepoint/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/ImportingCsvFileIntoMSSharepointIT.java#testImport (assertEquals local contacts.csv vs SharePoint content); operations from src/main/app/importing-a-csv-file-into-ms-sharepoint.xml sharepoint:folder-create / sharepoint:file-add overwrite="true"; move from file:inbound-endpoint moveToDirectory
